target: Incremental weekly PPR accuracy over the existing production model

gates.label: Chronological seasons
gates.requirement: At least two seasons with the latest untouched for testing.

gates.label: Position coverage
gates.requirement: Held-out QB, RB, WR, and TE coverage.

gates.label: Incremental held-out lift
gates.requirement: Combined features beat the existing forecast on the untouched season.

notes: Current lines may be displayed as shadow evidence but contribute zero recommendation weight.
Early-week and final pregame models are evaluated independently to prevent closing-line leakage.
A betting line is a market threshold, not an expected mean or a long-term dynasty valuation.
